name: northwoods-pack
description: Public PAI v0.1 modular monolith — 5 capabilities in one Worker. First reference deployment in progress.

scripts.deploy: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && node scripts/after-install.mjs
scripts.local:gate: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run coverage

DB.description: **Your memory.** Every identity field and every remembered thing lives here - in your account, deletable by you alone.

AI.description: **The built-in voice.** Your harness talks using your own account's Workers AI allocation - no other AI product required.
